Franz Kernel User ABI Definitions
Description

Master Application Binary Interface (ABI) definitions, system call offsets, and execution macros for the Franz RISC-V user environment.

ABI Base & Block Offsets
ABI_BASE

Location:  Register s1 Summary:  The master ABI pointer. The kernel pre-loads the base address (0x80201000) into this register.  Warning:  Users MUST NOT modify s1 if they intend to use kcall macros.

B0_OFF

Value:  0x000 Summary:  Block 0: I/O & Multimedia.

B1_OFF

Value:  0x800 Summary:  Block 1: CPU & Time (2048).

B2_OFF

Value:  0x1000 Summary:  Block 2: Memory & Data (4096).

B3_OFF

Value:  0x1800 Summary:  Block 3: Platform API (6144).

Block 0 - I/O & Multimedia
UART_PUTC

[Offset]  B0_OFF + 0x000 [Action]  Prints a single character to the console.

UART_PUTS

[Offset]  B0_OFF + 0x008 [Action]  Prints a null-terminated string.

UART_PUTHEX

[Offset]  B0_OFF + 0x010 [Action]  Prints a 64-bit value in hexadecimal.

UART_PUTDEC

[Offset]  B0_OFF + 0x018 [Action]  Prints a 64-bit value in decimal.

UART_GETC

[Offset]  B0_OFF + 0x020 [Action]  Retrieves a single character from input.

PX_GETW

[Offset]  B0_OFF + 0x200 [Action]  Returns pixel buffer width in pixels.

PX_GETH

[Offset]  B0_OFF + 0x208 [Action]  Returns pixel buffer height in pixels.

PX_BUFFER

[Offset]  B0_OFF + 0x210 [Action]  Returns the memory pointer to the start of the pixel buffer.

PX_SYNC

[Offset]  B0_OFF + 0x218 [Action]  Flushes buffer to display hardware (Sync).

SND_SET

[Offset]  B0_OFF + 0x400 [Action]  Configures global audio parameters.

NET_SUPPORT

[Offset]  B0_OFF + 0x600 [Action]  Returns networking capability flags.

Block 1 - CPU & Time
SYS_TIME

[Offset]  B1_OFF + 0x000 [Action]  Retrieves the current system uptime in microseconds.

SYS_CYCLES

[Offset]  B1_OFF + 0x008 [Action]  Retrieves the raw CPU cycle counter.

SYS_DELAY_US

[Offset]  B1_OFF + 0x010 [Action]  Blocks execution for the specified microseconds.

SYS_FREQ

[Offset]  B1_OFF + 0x018 [Action]  Returns the current CPU clock frequency.

SYS_CPUID

[Offset]  B1_OFF + 0x020 [Action]  Returns the Hart ID of the calling core.

SYS_FENCEI

[Offset]  B1_OFF + 0x028 [Action]  Synchronizes the instruction and data streams.

SYS_TIMER_SET

[Offset]  B1_OFF + 0x030 [Action]  Programs the next hardware timer interrupt.

SYS_ISA

[Offset]  B1_OFF + 0x038 [Action]  Returns a bitmask of supported RISC-V extensions.

SYS_HALT

[Offset]  B1_OFF + 0x040 [Action]  Terminates the current execution environment.

Block 2 - Memory & Data
MEM_COPY

[Offset]  B2_OFF + 0x000 Registers:

a0 : Destination address (dst)
a1 : Source address (src)
a2 : Length in bytes (len)
MEM_SET

[Offset]  B2_OFF + 0x008 Registers:

a0 : Destination address (dst)
a1 : Byte value to fill (val)
a2 : Length in bytes (len)
MEM_COMPARE

[Offset]  B2_OFF + 0x010 Registers:

a0 : ptr1 (returns result here)
a1 : ptr2
a2 : Length in bytes (len)
STR_LEN

[Offset]  B2_OFF + 0x020 Registers:

a0 : String pointer (returns length here)
MB_READ

[Offset]  B2_OFF + 0x400 Registers:

a0 : Mailbox read offset
MB_WRITE

[Offset]  B2_OFF + 0x408 Registers:

a0 : Mailbox write offset
a1 : 64-bit value to write
System Execution Macros
KCALL

Summary:  Primary system call invoker. Safely handles >2047 byte offsets.  Registers: - s1 : (Read-Only) Must contain the ABI base pointer.  - t5 : (Mutated) Used for the immediate 32-bit offset.  - t6 : (Mutated) Final jump address calculation.  - ra : (Mutated) Return address link.

SAVE_ALL

Summary:  Context save. Pushes all 32 GPRs to stack (256-byte frame).  Registers: - sp  : Decremented by 256.  - mscratch : Temporarily holds the original SP.  - x1-x31  : All general registers are saved to stack.

RESTORE_ALL

Summary:  Context restore. Pops all 32 GPRs and cleans the stack frame.  Registers: - sp  : Incremented by 256.  - x1-x31  : Overwritten with values from stack.
